S.FORM: == Chris Anstey == siwkay nizaː nalecuh ciniza i Melbourne, Victoria, nanu syubay kanas-mali miunduay nu Amilika NBA nisakaput, pahanhanan tu kawaw ayza. Chris Anstey i 1997 a mihcan NBA sapapili' mimaliay a kawaw, saka 1 ku uwac atu silsil 18, namapili' tu nu Portland Trail Blazers putiput. nalecuhan ciniza i 1 a bulad 1 a demiad, 1975 a mihcaan, Chris Anstey, miunduay. tatama u etul niza, i mali putiput a pueneng kakitizaan sa i tebanay . talakway a tademaw ciniza, izaw 213 kungfeng atu 115 kungcin. sikapahay a uzip niza, sisa namapili nu putiput i sakacacay ku uwac. kya syubay putiput sa ku Portland Trail Blazers.
